result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where restaurant metadata text overlaps and becomes unreadable.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text strings overlap each other, rendering both illegible.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time and delivery fee in a proper inline flex or text container with appropriate spacing and a separator (e.g., '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') instead of positioning them at overlapping coordinates.
